Row-space containment functions b_t have transforms T^t Gaussian-binomial(3−s,t)_2 (T=2^m), giving explicit λ0, λ1, λ2=H+TG, λ3=H where H=1−7u+14u⁴−8u⁹=−(u−1)(2u³−1)Q and G=u−3u⁴+2u⁹. Q′>0 for u≥0 and Q(1/8)<0<Q(1/6), so single low root ρ. λ1=(1−u)[nonnegative polynomial]. On [0,ρ], G≥0 so λ2>0; on (ρ,2^(−1/3)) λ3<0; on [2^(−1/3),1) G<0 and λ2≤H+8G=(u−1)R(u)<0 by R(3/4)>0 and R′>0. At u=1 all-ones rank one; at u=ρ only λ3 zero. Symbolically checked polynomial identity/factorizations and full integer Walsh transforms on m=3 and 4 for all characters, including multiplicity (T−1)(T−2)(T−4). The all-m result is analytic.
